subject.title: 34 built-in skills missing trigger phrases in description field

question: Should bundled skill descriptions be expanded with concise trigger/WHEN wording now, or should trigger-like routing move to a structured skill metadata contract instead?
rationale: Current source still uses descriptions as the prompt selection signal, but docs and related history also prioritize compact descriptions, so automation should not choose this public skill-authoring policy.

options.title: Approve concise description cleanup
options.body: Allow one focused metadata-only update that adds short WHEN wording only where it improves routing without bloating descriptions.

options.title: Defer to structured triggers
options.body: Keep descriptions compact and make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/76782 the canonical owner for exact keyword semantics.

options.title: Decline trigger expansion
options.body: Document that the current concise description style is intentional and close related cleanup attempts as not planned.

recommendation.title: Approve concise description cleanup
recommendation.body: Allow one focused metadata-only update that adds short WHEN wording only where it improves routing without bloating descriptions.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner has the strongest current and historical signal across skill docs, prompt-visible skill metadata, and representative bundled skills.
